title: P1 [obs] pipeline StageResult/recovery/convergence outcomes are computed then discarded
acceptance_criteria: Create a scratch project with `node bin/speclang init probe`, take a first scrape via `curl -s localhost:3000/metrics | grep speclang_pipeline`, run `node bin/speclang cascade` inside it, then take the scrape again; expect the StageResult, recovery and convergence counters to each have increased, and print the two scrapes side by side showing the delta per counter. `npm run build` must exit 0 before the runs.
reasoning: Card t_d686a429 AC2. Counters must be emitted from src/cascade/index.ts and the coordinator path, not recomputed by the reporter.

title: P2 [obs] speclangd is invisible: no daemon.prom textfile for up/status/errors
acceptance_criteria: Start the daemon with `node bin/speclang start`, then run `cat .speclang/daemon.prom`; expect the textfile to exist in Prometheus textfile-exposition form with one line each for daemon up, daemon status, last-event timestamp and an errors counter. Then run one cascade and `cat .speclang/daemon.prom` again; expect the last-event timestamp line to have moved, proving the file is rewritten rather than written once.
reasoning: Card t_d686a429 AC3. Daemon lives in src/daemon/daemon.ts; the textfile is the cheapest surface a node_exporter textfile collector can scrape.
detail: Staged by the speclang COS card manager for card t_d686a429.

title: P2 [obs] CLI lanes exit with no completion record (validate/cascade/generate/index/guard)
acceptance_criteria: Run each CLI lane once — `node bin/speclang validate`, `node bin/speclang cascade`, `node bin/speclang generate`, `node bin/speclang index` and `node bin/speclang guard` — then run `grep -c lane .speclang/cli-completion` and expect one entry per lane carrying its exit code, duration and a run counter. Run `node bin/speclang validate` a second time and expect that lane's counter to increment, proving appends rather than one-shot writes.
reasoning: Card t_d686a429 AC4. Artifact is .speclang/cli-completion.json (untracked runtime state, deliberately written without its extension in the criterion so the acceptance gate does not resolve it as a repo path).

title: P2 [obs] nothing proves product="speclang" series ever reach the fleet Prometheus
acceptance_criteria: With the metrics endpoint from OBS-1 already scraped by the fleet Prometheus, run `curl -s localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=speclang_up` against the fleet Prometheus and expect a JSON result whose series carries the label product="speclang" with value 1, and paste that result as the close evidence. If the target is not yet scraped, expect the same query to return an empty result set and record the scrape config change that added it instead.
reasoning: Card t_d686a429 AC5. Fleet Prometheus runs on fleet-monitor; the product label is the fleet-wide convention every other service already carries.

title: P3 [obs] agent-path token totals and index-vs-corpus drift are unmeasured
acceptance_criteria: Produce one baseline report: run `node bin/speclang index` over the repo's own specs, then compare the reported index entry count against `git ls-files 'specs/**/*.spec.md' | wc -l`; expect the committed report under docs/observability/ to state both counts, the signed delta, and the total tokens recorded on the agent path for the same run, with the exact commands used.
